description: OpenAI client call through OpenRouter, one chat turn, traced by OpenInference through cetra's SDK.
notes: The client keeps the real base URL https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, and the harness routes the request to the capture mock under that host (D-IN-3). cetra's SDK stamps the OpenAI client's host on the span as server.address openrouter.ai (D-IN-18), so the provider is openrouter from the endpoint rule (D-IN-2). The model openai/gpt-4o-mini is priced by OpenAI's gpt-4o-mini row through the gateway fallback (D-IN-13). Cost is computed, not reported. Token counts are input 14 and output 8.
